$comment: The major version lives in the $id path (/v1/), per JSON Schema's convention that a schema's identity carries its version (S11-SR-06). A backward-incompatible change to the matrix shape ships as /v2/…; the working file stays at specs/traceability.schema.json.
title: TraceabilityMatrix
description: Requirement traceability matrix for the JSON Schema Preview extension. Maps every requirement ID (defined in the specs directory) to its implementation status and the source files realising it.

$schema.description: Inline binding to this schema (F10 convention).

$comment.description: Human note about the file's purpose; ignored by tooling.

statuses.title: StatusDescriptions
statuses.description: Map of status name to its human-readable meaning.

requirements.title: RequirementMap
requirements.description: Map of requirement ID (e.g. F10-FR-04) to its traceability entry.

impl.description: Source files implementing this requirement (repo-relative paths).

specifiedAt.description: Day this requirement entered the matrix (S11-SR-07), stamped by check-traceability.mjs --init. Absent means the requirement predates lifecycle stamping and MUST NOT be assigned a date (S11-SR-09).

implementedAt.description: Day this requirement's status first reached implemented or manual (S11-SR-07). Only stamped for entries that carry specifiedAt.
